rows.title: Contract cleanup in one regeneration
rows.summary: Contract cleanup in one regeneration. rows.title: Engine cache settings on a profile, sized from the machine
rows.summary: Engine cache settings on a profile, sized from the machine. This means `--cache-ram`, `--cache-reuse` and `--ctx-checkpoints`, with a RAM cache computed from free RAM; vLLM's CPU KV offload; and admission counting both
rows.notes: The home of CB4's setting, DI2 and LD2. Measure llama-server's cache-update pause first. Call LD-C5

rows.title: Measure people served at a speed
rows.summary: Measure people served at a speed. A 1..N stream sweep through the gateway, adding agent-shaped load: hour-long sessions, the published pauses, and sub-agent bursts of 7-51. Report the knee, kept per runtime with its provenance
rows.from: DI3, LD5 (replaces the 1-256 load test and creators items 1 and 3)
rows.notes: Its result record is read by LD1's acceptance, DI5/LD3, the speed nudge and the creators' cards. Handoff `docs/private/handoff-di3.md`

rows.title: One fair queue in the gateway
rows.summary: One fair queue in the gateway. Waiting for a starting runtime, waiting for room in a pool, and a key over its concurrency limit become one queue, ordered by band, then person, then arrival. Refusals name their cause, and queue time is recorded
rows.who: every shared machine and agent user
rows.notes: One waiting mechanism before a second one appears. LD-C2 taken 2026-10-21: queue, reversing A5's no-queue rule. Calls LD-C3, LD-C4, WAKE and CB-C. One adversarial review

rows.title: Metrics export with names that last

rows.notes: Metric names become a public contract. Settle them once, before alerts and dashboards (row 38) depend on them

rows.title: Checked engine updates, and the drain they need
rows.summary: Checked engine updates, and the drain they need. Check a new build against the old one, roll the replicas, keep the old build on failure, and stop a gateway restart cutting streams

rows.notes: Every install updates engines. The drain is reused by rows 15 and 40. Call DI-C3
